documents.title: Perry County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 135 pages. Amounts are the Ordinance Section 5 budget amounts; categories from the detail report's 'Original Budget' column (Group Totals) column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
